rv.q: I was guffawing pretty much the entire time.
VAPE! IS the word and the show to see!
The production is a clever, well-written and professionally performed satire of all the characters, dialogue and songs in the film version of “Grease.”
A lively, clever night out, absolutely worthwhile if you’re in the mood for camp, nostalgia, and a show that knows exactly how ridiculous it wants to be.
Vape! attempts to capture the same irreverent energy that made recent parody hits like Titanique and Schmigadoon! work, but it struggles to carve out its own distinct identity.
My advice: Keep your hands clean of this Grease -y residue.
Vape! The Grease Parody is the show that Grease fans have been waiting for.
Vape! is often funny, but it’s hard to say what it’s ultimately about beyond “remember Grease?” and “oh, there’s a moment of homage to another musical or movie.”
Vape! doesn’t quite hit the mark for a hilarious parody, but there were a few chuckles here and there.

cn.t: This affectionate parody of the beloved musical earns mixed-to-positive reviews for its campy humor and energy, though critics split on whether the jokes justify a full-length show, with some finding it very funny and others questioning its target audience.
